title: Chatham Historical Society

services.name: Cabin Fever Series
services.desc: Local Connecticut authors share history and folklore across three Saturday talks each winter, co-sponsored with the East Hampton Public Library. This is an annual Chatham Historical Society tradition. Stay tuned for updates on the 2027 series. Monica Peterson weaves vivid tales for audiences young and old, offering both fascinating historical sagas and timeless folklore. She performs in costume, featuring photos and artifacts that complement each tale. Monica Peterson has entertained at the JFK Presidential Library, the Children's Museum of the Arts in Manhattan, the New Britain Museum of American Art, and the Connecticut Storytelling
